qualification.interval: from 63 samples after the last counter channel's acquisition to 63 samples before the capture's end
qualification.observed_only: logged capture losses are not observed time
qualification.capture_rule: capture past the required duration at both ends by the guards and by any logged loss, inside the soak window
qualification.verdict: every verdict states the interval; PASS needs at least required_s observed seconds in it; a shorter interval is NOT RUN

counter_limits: every slip is sized exactly from the decoded position
a slip of whole 2048-sample blocks is found within 63 samples and carries located_within, the samples it may have happened at

inside a cluster of events less than 64 samples apart, the slips between them take the smallest sizes the positions allow, and a code bit those sizes leave unexplained reads as a code-bit corruption; the cluster's total is exact
a word equal to a neighbouring received word is a repeat
an excursion of two or more words with one constant XOR mask is one corruption at any length, even where slips would produce the same words
a stretch longer than 65536 words without 64 clean samples is graded in pieces; a constant-mask corruption stays a bit-flip with that mask in each
at either end of a capture, words that differ from their track only in the code bit are one unresolved event: a slip of whole blocks or a code-bit corruption, with located_within for the slip
any other slip that 64 clean samples cannot confirm, in a capture's last samples or inside a constant-mask excursion the capture ends in, carries unresolved
nothing outside the qualified interval is proved clean
audio_integrity.planted_placement: a drop, a repeat and a flip in the first tenth of the capture and again in its last tenth, inside the qualified interval, logged with capture index, channel and size or mask
audio_integrity.capture_start: once the counter flows on every channel; words before a channel's acquisition are graded against the track it acquires, so leading silence fails; a channel that has not acquired within 65536 frames voids the run
audio_integrity.capture_losses: logged by the capture tool inside the qualified interval; attributed to the capture and reported apart; a loss advances the acquisition index and both clocks
audio_integrity.pass_rule: zero DUT-attributed events on every bound channel, both directions, with every planted arm found, over a qualified interval of at least required_s observed seconds
audio_integrity.window_rule: start after soak.continuous binds every pair and starts timing; end at or before its endpoint; the soak outlasts duration_s by the capture's guards and logged losses
